{{Quote|The War Trust has stretched the Republic's resources and fought us to a standstill time and again. They are master strategists.|Darth Baras describes the War Trust to his apprentice|<ref name="Check In" />}}
The '''War Trust''' was an unofficial division within the [[Republic Strategic High Command]] that consisted of four [[General/Legends|generals]]: [[Elaxis Frellka]], [[Minst]], [[Durant]], and [[Faraire]]. Reporting directly to the [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]], the generals operate as a "think tank" for republic military planning. Though their identities and activities are classified, it is believed that the The War Trust was responsible for most of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] every major military campaign since the beginning of the [[Great Galactic War]], as well as for innovations and tactics during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Behind the scenes==
The War Trust first appeared in the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[2011]]. The elimination of the four Republic generals that comprised the group was the focal point of the Sith Warrior class story on Taris.<ref name="Check In" />
